gloss: sum of money; fee; charge; allowance (suffix)

definitions.gloss: sum of money; fee; charge; benefit payment
definitions.explanation: Attached to a noun to name a specific sum of money set aside, owed, or paid out for the purpose named by the base word. Extremely productive in contracts, invoices, and administrative Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}{金|きん}→入学金：22398_nyuugakukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{未払|みはら}い{金|きん}→未払い金：30179_miharaikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三万円|さんまんえん}⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
⟦{退職|たいしょく}{金|きん}→退職金：07959_taishokukin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{勤続|きんぞく}{年数|ねんすう}→勤続年数：25628_kinzokunensuu⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The amount of the retirement allowance is determined by length of service.

notes:
Names a designated sum of money rather than money in general.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: charge; fare
- ⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧: payment for goods; price
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧: cash
- ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧: savings
- ⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧: deposit; security money
- ⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧: pension

SIMILAR SUFFIXES:
- 〜⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧: fee charged for a service (⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧, ⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧) — narrower than 〜⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧
- 〜⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: expense; cost incurred (⟦{交通|こうつう}{費|ひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧, ⟦{生活|せいかつ}{費|ひ}→生活費：19424_seikatsuhi⟧) — money spent, not a sum set aside
